title: Adobe to Acquire Figma
notes: Original transaction announcement; approximately $20B, about half cash and half stock, subject to regulatory approvals and other closing conditions.

title: Adobe Form 8-K — merger agreement
notes: Adobe filing announcing execution of the Agreement and Plan of Merger.

title: Agreement and Plan of Merger — Adobe / Figma
notes: Controlling contract. Section 8.2 sets $1B termination fee mechanics and expressly states the fee is not a penalty but liquidated damages.

title: Figma Consent Solicitation Statement / Adobe Prospectus (424B3)
publisher: U.S. SEC / Adobe Inc. / Figma Inc.
notes: Detailed deal background, negotiation chronology, regulatory conditions and reverse termination fee summary; Annex A reproduces merger agreement.

title: Adobe Form 10-Q — Figma acquisition risk / reverse termination fee
notes: Adobe states $1B reverse termination fee would apply if regulatory clearance failed under specified conditions or transaction failed to close within 18 months.

title: Adobe / Figma merger inquiry
case_name: Anticipated acquisition of Figma, Inc. by Adobe Inc.
notes: Canonical UK case page. Inquiry opened May 3; Phase 2 referral July 13; provisional findings Nov 28; inquiry cancelled after abandonment; case closed Dec 19.

title: Adobe / Figma deal could harm UK digital design sector
case_name: Anticipated acquisition of Figma, Inc. by Adobe Inc.
notes: CMA press release summarizing provisional findings; expressly provisional and subject to consultation/final decision.

title: Notice of Possible Remedies — Adobe / Figma
case_name: Anticipated acquisition of Figma, Inc. by Adobe Inc.
notes: Possible remedies included prohibition or structural divestiture; document is a consultation-stage remedies notice, not a final order.

title: Parties’ Joint Response to CMA Issues Statement
publisher: Adobe Inc. / Figma Inc. via CMA
case_name: Anticipated acquisition of Figma, Inc. by Adobe Inc.
notes: Parties' advocacy record. They argued their products were complementary and the transaction pro-competitive; use only as attributed position, not independent finding.

title: Parties’ Response to CMA Notice of Possible Remedies
publisher: Adobe Inc. / Figma Inc. via CMA
case_name: Anticipated acquisition of Figma, Inc. by Adobe Inc.
notes: Parties strongly disagreed with provisional findings and said remedies notice effectively pointed to prohibition or divestiture of Figma Design.

title: Competition Merger Brief 2/2024 — M.11033 Adobe/Figma
author: DG COMP staff
notes: Official Commission staff brief. Records notification June 30 2023, Phase II opening Aug 7, Statement of Objections Nov 17, abandonment Dec 18, and that investigation ended without a formal Commission decision. Brief itself states authors' views do not bind Commission.

title: Antitrust AAG Kanter Statement After Adobe and Figma Abandon Merger
author: Jonathan Kanter
court_or_agency: U.S. Department of Justice — Antitrust Division
notes: Confirms DOJ Antitrust Division conducted an investigation and publicly welcomed abandonment. Does not establish that DOJ filed a lawsuit.

title: Adobe and Figma Mutually Agree to Terminate Merger Agreement
notes: Joint announcement: companies said no clear path to necessary regulatory approvals from EC and CMA; both continued to disagree with regulatory findings.

title: Adobe Form 8-K — mutual termination
notes: Reports Dec 17 mutual termination; $1B cash termination payment due within three business days; fee described as sole and exclusive remedy under termination arrangement.

title: Mutual Termination Agreement — Adobe / Figma
notes: Signed termination agreement. Calls $1B payment liquidated damages, sets payment within three business days, and makes it Figma's sole/exclusive remedy under the merger agreement.

title: Adobe FY2023 Form 10-K
notes: Adobe confirms it paid Figma $1B on Dec 20, 2023 using cash on hand and recorded fee in operating expenses in Q1 FY2024.

title: Adobe FY2024 Form 10-K
notes: Confirms approximately $20B proposed consideration; $1B termination fee recorded in FY2024 operating expenses and not tax-deductible for financial statement purposes.

title: Figma Form S-1 Registration Statement
notes: Figma's own public-company filing confirms Dec 17 termination based on no clear path to approvals, Dec 20 receipt of $1B, and abandoned-merger financial history.

title: Figma 2025 Form 10-K
notes: Current post-deal source. Confirms $1B receipt, independent-company history, and IPO completion Aug 1, 2025 at $33/share; do not imply merger fee caused IPO outcome.

title: A New Collaboration with Adobe
author: Dylan Field
notes: Figma's original announcement of agreed acquisition; party perspective.

title: Figma and Adobe are abandoning our proposed merger
author: Dylan Field
notes: Figma says after 15 months of regulatory review the companies no longer saw a path toward regulatory approval and Figma would continue independently.
